title: La Liga kicks off this weekend, energizing European football
seoTitle: La Liga kicks off this weekend as European season begins
subtitle: The Spanish league kicks off with José Mourinho's return to Real Madrid and new clashes across Europe.
excerpt: The football season in Spain and other European leagues begins with new squads, managerial changes, and confirmed schedules.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The European football calendar springs into action with the opening round of the Spanish League this weekend, kicking off the cycle of competitions on the continent. The start of matches in Spain precedes the debut of other national tournaments, such as the French, Italian, and German leagues, which begin in the following weeks.

The return of José Mourinho and changes at Real Madrid

Real Madrid begins the tournament under the management of coach José Mourinho, who left Benfica to return to the Spanish club thirteen years after the end of his first spell. The manager takes over a team that has gone two seasons without winning a title, relying on names like Kylian Mbappe, Vinicius Junior, and Jude Bellingham in the attacking line.

To adjust the team's composition, the club made signings in the transfer market, including Marc Cucurella, Ibrahima Konate, Denzel Dumfries, and Bernardo Silva, as well as Yan Diomande for the attacking sector.

Barcelona seeks new title and the outlook for Spanish rivals

As the reigning champion and favorite for a third consecutive league title, Barcelona, under the guidance of Hansi Flick, sought reinforcements with the arrivals of Anthony Gordon and Karim Adeyemi to replace the goals of Robert Lewandowski. Meanwhile, Atlético de Madrid aims to contend for the top positions, alongside teams like Villarreal and Real Betis.

At the bottom of the table, Málaga is trying to remain in the top flight with a modest squad after operating under administration since 2020. While Valencia plays its final year at the Mestalla stadium, Rayo Vallecano had its stadium license revoked by the Madrid regional government due to the precarious state of the facilities.

Dates and clashes in the Italian and German leagues

The Italian first division begins on Saturday, August 22, with matches between Udinese and Como, as well as Inter Milan and Monza. Inter Milan takes the field to defend its national title, while Como embarks on its journey after securing a Champions League spot under the management of Cesc Fàbregas.

In Germany, the first clash takes place on Friday, August 28, between Bayern Munich and Stuttgart. The team managed by Vincent Kompany is betting on Harry Kane, who has 98 goals in 94 games in the German league, while the club from Elversberg makes its first appearance in the top division.

Season openers in France and Turkey

The French League has its first match scheduled for August 21, with the clash between Olympique de Marseille and Strasbourg. Paris Saint-Germain added Maghnes Akliouche and Lucas Digne to their squad, while Monaco is now coached by former full-back Felipe Luis.

In Turkey, the national league began on August 14 with the match between Galatasaray and Corum. The Turkish tournament welcomed international athletes in this transfer window, including Dusan Vlahovic, Romelu Lukaku, and Mohamed Salah, who signed with Trabzonspor.

With information from LiveScore, BBC.
